doc: Build-time reference of names for the tools (Pierre, 2026-11-05, Q49): the app never loads it, and it never changes the IMR wording (rule C1). Refreshed by tools/taxonomy.py from WoRMS and iNaturalist; its docstring describes every field. Hand-kept: refs, watch (all but seen) and the names in old; the rest is written by the refresh. Study: docs/reviews/2026-11-05-coral-taxonomy-study.md section 5.

imr: Septa alternate in size; formerly Montastrea / Phymastrea.

flags: family: the app says Diploastreidae, WoRMS Diploastraeidae

imr: Instructor's notes: Dipsastraea now includes only intra-tentacular, separate-walled corals; Favites covers the extra-tentacular corals with shared or separate walls (Favites still under review).
The species here is D. peltata (formerly Turbinaria peltata, Coral Finder p50).

flags: family: the app says Agariciidae, WoRMS Pachyseridae
family: the app says Euphylliidae, WoRMS Plerogyridae

watch.what: Favites revision: Kishi, Johnson & Fukami 2025 split F. irregularis from F. valenciennesii (WoRMS has it, iNaturalist not yet on 2026-11-05); Favites is still not a natural group (Huang et al. 2014)
Fungia fungites hides a second species in a genus not yet named (Oku et al. 2020)
Tubipora: 15 lineages where one species, T. musica, was used (Macrina et al. 2026); a formal revision is pending
Cyphastrea agassizi belongs with Leptastrea (Chukaew et al. 2023); WoRMS has not followed
